metadata.description: Operator-guided context pruning for Claude Code. Two plugins: prune (skills + statusline, the everyday tool) and prune-watch (optional channel-based proactive nudges).

plugins.name: prune
plugins.description: Slash commands /prune:distill (transcript-bucketing prune), /prune:handover (in-context brief), /prune:resume (pick the newest brief back up, no filename to type), /prune:setup (onboarding diagnostic), an unattended tmux /clear → /prune:resume cycle, plus a statusline script that surfaces a visible nudge when context crosses the prune threshold. No background process, no MCP server — install this one for the everyday flow.

plugins.name: prune-watch
plugins.description: Optional companion to the prune plugin. Adds the original channel watcher: a background MCP server that tails the active transcript and pushes a one-way <channel> nudge when context crosses ~200k tokens. Also exposes check/snooze/unsnooze MCP tools that /prune:distill integrates with automatically when this plugin is installed. Requires --dangerously-load-development-channels at claude launch to deliver nudges.
